description: Safely releases a stale open Boardroom todo from its current assignee so another worker can claim it. The server refuses fresh owners, protected human/manual work, in-progress work, unassigned work, capped reclaim attempts, and rows that changed during release. agent_id required.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the calling agent.

todo_id.description: UUID of the stale open todo claim to release

name: release_claim
title: Release a stale Boardroom claim
